title: SPARC Cat - Sham Control Chronic Cat 1, Day 14
author: Brett Hanzlicek
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bfzhjp36
materials: Transport cat from housing site to surgery site.

steps.title: Prepare Animal for Surgery
steps.instruction: Anesthetize the cat, shave the abdomen, and move the animal to the surgery room to be attached to monitors.

steps.title: Sterilize Surgical Site
steps.instruction: Drape the animal and perform a betadine scrub on the abdomen and genitals.

steps.title: Insert Bladder Catheter
steps.instruction: Insert a 3.5Fr catheter lubricated with surgilube into the bladder via the urethra.

substeps.instruction: Advance the catheter until resistance is met

steps.title: Collect Urine Sample
steps.instruction: Use gentle suction with a syringe to withdraw urine from the bladder through the catheter.

steps.title: Perform Bladder CT Imaging
steps.instruction: Visualize the bladder using a 1:5 dilution of contrast to saline.

substeps.instruction: Fill the bladder with 10 mL contrast and take a single CT image
Add 5 mL more contrast (total 15 mL) and take a single CT image
Take a 3D CT image with 15 mL contrast:saline in the bladder

steps.title: Set Up Urodynamics Equipment
steps.instruction: Transfer the cat from Isoflurane to propofol anesthetic and configure the pressure recording system.

substeps.instruction: Connect an external pressure transducer to the syringe pump on one end and the catheter tubing on the other
Set up data recording using Labview software
Set syringe pump fill rate to 2ml saline/minute

steps.title: Perform Round 1 Urodynamics
steps.instruction: Fill the bladder with saline and record the pressure using the pressure transducer connected to LabView.

substeps.instruction: Fill to 28.6 mL to end round 1 urodynamics

steps.title: Perform Round 2 Urodynamics
steps.instruction: Fill the bladder with saline at a rate of 2ml/min.

substeps.instruction: Fill to 19 mL to end round 2 urodynamics

steps.title: Post-Procedure Recovery
steps.instruction: Wait for the cat to wake up and return it to the housing site.
